text:
Type: southwestern diamond throw pillow
Use: decorating and resting on a sofa, bed or armchair; living room, bedroom
Style: rustic, bohemian, farmhouse
Materials: textured woven fabric
Colors: ivory, beige, taupe, grey, black accents
Shape: square, stepped diamond grid pattern with small black dashes, knife edges, compact
Feel: warm, earthy, textured
Goes with: leather or linen sofas, warm wood, neutral walls; rustic or bohemian living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Southwestern Diamond Patterned Decorative Throw Pillow, 17" x 17", Ivory
product.description: The woven Southwestern-inspired pattern adds a pop of modern design, while neutral greys and tans allow it to blend with transitional or modern décor. For a different look, flip it over to show the solid flax-colored reverse side. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 17"L x 17"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat. Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
